Horizon Grid

Altitude every 10°, azimuth every 15°.

Divisions

Marks on the zodiac band (or along the ecliptic when the band is off), in the chosen zodiac.

DECAN GUIDES
BOUNDS

Decan Guides sit on the band's bottom edge. Each bound shows its Guide's glyph: Ptolemaic on the top edge, Egyptian on the bottom edge (one row in when the Decan Guides are on).

Declination

Each rainbow band is shared by the two signs that reach the same declinations. The zodiac band's colors step aside while the rainbow is on.

Grids

Houses

Tap the Houses icon to step through lines, degrees, degree sign minute, and off. Each house line runs through its cusp's zodiac degree and the poles of the ecliptic (In Zodiaco).

HOUSE LABELS
CUSP DEGREES

Small gold circles on the ecliptic, 90° from the Ascendant: the highest point of the ecliptic, and its lowest, below the horizon.

Sky

PROJECTION

Stereographic keeps shapes true, as in Stellarium. Perspective (gnomonic) draws great circles straight. The camera always uses Perspective.

Camera

The live camera behind the sky. Selfie puts the sky behind you.

CAPTURE

With Microphone on, videos record sound.

If the stars drift from the real ones toward the screen's edges, slide Match Camera until they line up.
